opening.argument: The presentation packages a front-running bot as an easy passive-income method that anyone can use. Viewers are instructed to deploy a contract, pay gas fees, fund it with ether, and activate it to inspect the mempool and front-run transactions. The promotion is reinforced by a claimed example profit of about $91 minus gas fees and reported earnings of more than two ether per week. Although the speaker concedes that profitability fluctuates and is not always achieved, the method is still presented through attractive returns and requires viewers to commit funds and transaction fees. The available evidence does not independently establish that the bot works or that the reported figures are accurate.

citations.quote: It's easy to set up, it requires no prior knowledge, anyone can do it.
Click the deploy button to publish our contract to the Ethereum blockchain. We need to confirm the creation of our contract by paying some gas fees.
the next step is to fund our contract with some ethers to be able to snipe liquidity. Pools.
usually I make. 2 plus ethereum a week.
Sometimes it's not always profitable and profits fluctuate week to week
